summary: The Layers panel now includes an arrow-triggered native opacity slider alongside numeric entry. Dragging previews the canvas; Return or outside dismissal commits one shared opacity command, and Escape preserves document/history/dirty state. Keyboard arrows use 1% steps and Shift uses 10%. All 69 focused and 2770 full optimized tests pass on 2470 frozen inputs; native slider/history checks and separate Preview272 packaging are verified.

Physical pointer sampling and large-document slider frame rate remain unqualified.
